dex.text: A house spirit no bigger than a cat that lives behind the range. Keep it sweet with a dish of cream. Forget, and your milk turns and your clogs go missing.
dex.fact: A boggart is a mischievous household spirit from northern English folklore. It is said that if you give one a name, it can no longer be reasoned with.

dex.text: A full-grown boggart, sooty, long-armed and sulking in the wooded clough. Moving house won't shake it off. It will already be in the removals van.
dex.fact: Boggart Hole Clough, a wooded park in Blackley, north Manchester, is named after one. In an old tale a farmer moved out to escape it, and a voice in the milk churn piped up: 'Aye, we're flitting!'
